I am p3 with $785 and own only VERMONT_AVENUE. I just traded $400 plus ST_CHARLES_PLACE and PENNSYLVANIA_RAILROAD to p1. p1 now holds the pink set but lacks Virginia Avenue.

I broke p1's orange monopoly by taking Vermont Avenue. They still own Indiana Avenue and Marvin Gardens. I have no color set yet.

I mistakenly thought I broke p1's orange monopoly. VERMONT_AVENUE is light blue, not orange. I need to re-evaluate the color sets.

I still need two more light blue properties to complete that set. p1's holdings are scattered across pink, orange, red, and yellow.

p2 has only the B&O Railroad and $1,262. p4 has no properties and $1,475. I realize the trade was a massive overpay for a single light blue property.

I cannot mortgage or trade away my only property. Oriental and Connecticut are unowned, so I cannot acquire them through trade.

No player holds a complete color set. The board is wide open. I cannot trade for another property to build a monopoly.

I will end the turn.
